raw_market.question: 1Q Spread: Browns (-10.5)
raw_market.description:
In the first quarter of the NFL game between Browns and Jets, scheduled for October 11 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Browns" if the Browns outscore the Jets by 11 or more points in the first quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Jets".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
